speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Right-sided acetabular fracture.

Based on your immediate right groin pain and abnormal leg positioning after being restrained in a rear-end collision, I need to confirm if you have a visible deformity or inability to bear weight on the right leg. Can you also describe if the pain radiates down your leg or if you feel numbness?
